author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Gazelle in profile facing right: rounded rump, level back, neck curving up to the nape, sloping forehead with a round muzzle, rounded chest and a belly tucked up between the legs; an S-curved horn sweeps back to the top edge; four thin legs in a walking stride. Naturally asymmetric. No Lucide match (Lucide rabbit/squirrel-style silhouette construction).
omissions: The reference's pair of horns and its ear merge into one swept horn; the two thin lines of each leg become single strokes, and the leg pairs are spread (8 apart) instead of close together.
